title: Guest Service Fee Refund Computation Standard — Refunded Fee Base
content:
# Guest service fee refund — computation standard

**Clause.** On a guest cancellation of a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, the refunded fee base is the nightly, cleaning-fee, pet-fee and extra-guest-fee amounts the stay's ledger shows refunded on the guest cancellation, every amount the guest service fee was charged on. The guest-service-fee refund is 14.20 percent of the refunded fee base, rounded half up to the cent, and the whole of it is paid to the guest's card.

## What enters the refunded fee base

| Refund entry on the stay's ledger | In the refunded fee base |
|---|---|
| nightly refund, guest-cancellation reason | yes |
| cleaning-fee refund, guest-cancellation reason | yes |
| pet-fee refund, guest-cancellation reason | yes |
| extra-guest-fee refund, guest-cancellation reason | yes |
| occupancy-tax refund | no — the guest service fee was not charged on it |
| any refund with another reason (host cancellation, travel issue, alteration, major disruptive event) | no |

## Worked figure (hypothetical ledger)

| Guest-cancellation refunds on the ledger | Amount |
|---|---|
| Nightly | 600.00 |
| Cleaning fee | 100.00 |
| Pet fee | 30.00 |
| Extra-guest fee | none |
| Refunded fee base | 730.00 |

Guest-service-fee refund: 14.20% of 730.00, which is 103.66, paid in full to the guest's card.

If the same ledger later also showed a guest-cancellation extra-guest-fee refund of 20.00, the refunded fee base would be 750.00 and the refund 106.50.
